requirements.text: * 1 to 3 years of experience shipping production-grade backend systems, or exceptional new graduates with strong portfolios demonstrating real execution
* Solid fundamentals in backend engineering: services, APIs, data models, and infrastructure designed for reliability, observability, security, and performance
* Applied AI builder who has shipped at least one meaningful AI-powered project (production, open-source, or a serious side project) and understands the gap between a demo and a reliable system
* Comfort working in a hands-on, high-ownership environment with senior engineers, taking real features from design through production with increasing autonomy
* **Location:** San Francisco, CA (in-office 4 days per week; Wednesdays flexible)
* Experience with AI orchestration patterns, LLM pipelines, evals, or agentic workflows in production
* Background working in or alongside full-stack teams, comfortable contributing across the stack when the scope demands it
* Familiarity with enterprise-grade security requirements: tenant isolation, auditability, least-privilege access
* AI-native development habits: uses AI tooling fluently across the software development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality
